blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Phoenix has tapped Marcellus Earlington as a replacement import for BJ Johnson ahead of next week’s resumption of the PBA Governors’ Cup. Coach Charles Tiu said Earlington arrived last week to take the place of Johnson, who left the Fuel Masters during the break to join Russian club Parma BC. Earlington saw action when the Fuel Masters lost to Mongolian side Omni Erdenet Miners, 83-80, in Wednesday’s tune-up game at Activate Hoop Arena in Mandaluyong City. “We just saw him online [and we feel like he] plays good basketball.
